## Module checklist
- [ ] **Learn:** lectures / reading (with the bot's predict checkpoints)
- [ ] **Practise:** problem sets / exercises (CS50 problem sets: only the CS50 Duck helps)
- [ ] **Remix:** branch `m<x.y>-remix`, build it, tests green locally
- [ ] **PR:** opened with the template filled in
- [ ] **Review:** read the bot's review, fixed what's needed
- [ ] **Explain-back:** `/check` in Telegram, passed
- [ ] **Merge:** both checks green, merged; this issue closes
